//: WIP file for all limby mutations, remove all but the limbs after submitting
description: Your eyes bulge out several inches from your skull.  This does not affect your vision in any way.

//: Slightly larger, but still boring eyes
name: bulging eyes
heading: Blg Eyes

//: Precursor to full cephalopod eyes, replaces all eye-related mutations for now
description: Your eyes still bulge, yet your pupils look different somehow.  Seeing under water poses no problem, but you are still getting used to the novel information.

//: Same size as bulging, plus high glare and eye membrane
name: cephalopod eyes
heading: Ceph Eyes

//: +10 tiles NV, double glare duration
description: Your brain has caught up with your eyes.  You can see much better in the dark, but sunlight seems much brighter.

//: Great night vision, TODO: Read in darkness?

description: Much of your face is taken up by a pair of gigantic compound eyes, partly wrapping around your temples.  Your detail vision suffered terribly, and the expanded field of view is dizzying.

//: Replaces your head.  Vision score lower, removed hardcoded per bonus.
name: compound eyes
heading: Comp.  Eyes

description: Your brain has had time to catch up to your gigantic, rainbow eyes.  The world around you is still less sharp than you remember, but things move somehow…slower these days.

//: Reaction score, raised vision score (getting used to it), still a large target.
Removes conflicting traits but no limb on its own
description: Your eyes have turned… green.  It's tough to tell the exact shade, as it seems to shift.  The effect is… pleasant.

//: +4,5 tiles NV = 3 NVSC, slight vision increase, sets you up for mutation progress.
description: Your corneas have taken on the same shifting green as your irises, and golden veins shift below its surface in a mesmerizing dance.  The shadows don't seem nearly as dark now.

//: Slightly better, still pretty, NV
name: iridescent eyes
heading: Elfa Eyes

//: +10 tiles NV = 4.5 NVSC, better vision for maximum elfishness
description: You have great low-light vision now, but it doesn't allow you to perform fine tasks such as crafting and reading in darkness.  Your day vision also grew considerably more sharp.

//: Getting very good at playing Legolas

description: Your eyes have grown slightly and mutated; now you have slit pupils, and they glitter in the light, much like a cat's.  This is visually striking, but it isn't helping you see at night - in fact, your vision has grown slightly blurry and color seem a bit washed out.

//: Slightly larger, but smaller than bulging eyes, lower vision score
name: feline eyes
heading: Fel.  Eyes

//: +4,5 tiles NV, bad vision score, +reaction score, faster adjustment
description: Whatever changes your eyes were going through are done - you see very well at night, and have excellent reactions, but you remember the world being much…sharper.

//: Good nightvision and reactions, worse resolution

description: Your visual processing has shifted: though you can see better in the dark, you're nearsighted in the light.  Maybe glasses would help.

//: Good nightvision, shortsighted in the light
+ 1 tiles nightvision range, +4 PER --> amazing vision score, some NV?
description: Your vision has become particularly acute: you suspect you could pick out zombies much farther away.

Like a true fish, your eyes lack eyelids, and are instead covered by a translucent, protective membrane that blocks irritants and water, and provides minor armor.  It also allows you to sleep with your eyes open!

//: PER + 1 ?
description: Your eyes barely protrude from your head on tentacles, preventing the use of any rigid eyewear.  On the plus side, you can have additional awareness, but sometimes your vision goes wonky as your brain tries to process the new angles.  You periodically feel a strain at the base of the stalk, as if it still tried to grow…

//: PER + 2 ? Reaction score for mobility?
description: Your eyes protrude from your head on flexible tentacles, preventing the use of any eyewear.  On the plus side, you can see in two directions at once, and they automatically retract to reduce damage.
Your eyes have mutated, with a brilliant iris and slitted pupil similar to that of a lizard.  This is visually striking, but doesn't seem to affect your vision.

//: Extra pit organ on top, instead of going through the eyes?
description: Your optic nerves and brain have mutated to catch up with your eyes, allowing you to see in the infrared spectrum.

//: Batrachians don't need Ursine/SEESLEEP anymore: Bulging eyes + EYE_MEMBRANE + SEESLEEP + MYOPIC_IN_LIGHT, bit of NV, bit of RS
description: Your eyes bulge noticeably out of your face, and you are able to move them much more freely than before.  You can see movement and close objects clearly, but you have trouble picking up distant details in the light.

Your eyes have grown extremely well-suited to the complete darkness of your preferred home.  You have excellent low-light vision, and can even see in infrared, but bright lights leave you disoriented longer.

//: +2 tiles NV, no VISION type to allow springling some on-top NV
description: You possess natural night vision, and can see further in the dark than most.  Activate to toggle NV-visible areas on or off.

//: +4,5 tiles NV
description: You can see incredibly well in the dark!  Activate to toggle NV-visible areas on or off.

//: +10 tiles NV
description: You can see in pitch blackness as if you were wearing night-vision goggles.  Activate to toggle NV-visible areas on or off.

//: Less likely to fall on rollerskates, prevents stumbling in combat, more likely to steal successfully
description: While you're not any better at melee combat, you are better at recovering from a miss, and will be able to attempt another strike faster.
Your wounds heal themselves quicker than usual.  You heal 50% faster whilst asleep, and 20% faster whilst awake.  Your broken limbs also heal twice as fast.
Your scent is quite weak.  Animals that track your scent will do so with more difficulty.
Instead of renewung miniscule amounts constantly, your old skin periodically comes off in palm-sized flecks.  Not as painful as it sounds, but it does itch like hell occasionally.
Your skin spontaneously forms small, calcified spirals.  They are mildly annoying, but otherwise without any effect.  Maybe you'll get a proper shell soon.
A pair of flabby tentacles grows out from beyond your eyes.  They are very sensitive to touch, and you can retract them surprisingly far, but they are otherwise useless.

//: Rolled into Trog Eyes, valid false and no category to prevent newly mutating it
description: Your eyes have mutated to pick up radiation in the infrared spectrum.

//: MOUTH
description: Your teeth have grown into two-inch-long fangs, allowing you to make an extra attack when conditions favor it.

//: Spawns a bone by shedding a tooth once a day
description: Your teeth have grown incredibly sharp, and have calcified even further.  In addition to letting you eat much faster, you can use them as a lethal natural weapon, as long as your anatomy favors it.  They also grow very fast, and you harmlessly shed them more or less at random.

attacks.attack_text_u: You tear into %s with your teeth

description: Your fangs have grown extremely large and incredibly sharp.  They make it impossible to wear mouthgear and difficult to eat… but leave nasty wounds when you bite.

attacks.attack_text_u: You tear into %s with your saber teeth
attacks.attack_text_npc: %1$s tears into %2$s with their saber teeth

description: Your big teeth have grown in.  Folks had best show some more respect.

attacks.attack_text_u: You bite into %s with your ratlike incisors

description: A set of tentacles surrounds your mouth.  They allow you to eat twice as fast.  Slightly decreases wet penalties.
A set of insect-like mandibles have grown around your mouth.  They allow you to eat faster and provide a slicing unarmed attack, but prevent wearing mouthwear.  Slightly reduces wet effects.
Your mandibles have developed extensible fangs, allowing you to bite quickly or ensure your venom goes home, as desired.
Your face resembles that of a bull, with a significant snout.  It looks fearsome but prevents wearing mouthgear.
Your jaw and nose have extended into a wolfish muzzle.  It lends itself to biting in combat and looks impressive, but prevents wearing mouthgear.
Your jaw and nose have extended into a bearish muzzle.  You could bite with it, and it looks impressive, but it prevents wearing mouthgear.
Your face and jaw have extended, giving you an alert and attentive appearance.
Your face and jaws are a shorter version of those found on alligators.  They look NASTY--as do the bite wounds they can inflict--but prevent wearing mouthgear.

attacks.attack_text_u: You bite a chunk out of %s

description: Your nose has morphed into a cute bunny nose, along with the snout.  It's extremely twitchy too.
Your face and jaws have widened like a frogs.  It looks hideous but it allows you to eat food whole.
You've gotten rid of that terribly imprecise mouth and now imbibe your food like a proper person.  Chewing was tiresome anyway.
You have a beak for a mouth.  You can occasionally use it to peck at your enemies, but it is impossible for you to wear mouth gear.  Slightly reduces wet effects.

//: Attack does up to 6x10 stab dmg, dependent on dex and unarmed skill
description: Pecking at prey is part of your daily routine now.  Slightly reduces wet effects.

attacks.attack_text_u: You jackhammer into %s with your beak

description: Though your beak's not suitable for pecking, those flowers out there are a good source of energy.  Examine them to feed.

//: EXTRA ON HEAD
description: You have a pair of small horns on your head.  They allow you to make a weak piercing headbutt attack.
You have a pair of large curled horns, like those of a ram.  They allow you to make a strong bashing headbutt attack, but prevent wearing any headwear.

attacks.attack_text_u: You headbutt %s with your curled horns

description: You have a pair of long, pointed horns, like those of an antelope.  They allow you to make a strong piercing headbutt attack, but prevent wearing headwear that is not made of fabric.

attacks.attack_text_u: You stab %s with your pointed horns

description: You have a huge rack of antlers, like those of a moose.  They allow you to make a weak headbutt attack, but prevent wearing headwear that is not made of fabric.
You have a pair of antennae.  They allow you to detect the presence of monsters up to a few tiles away, even if you can't see or hear them, but prevent wearing headwear that is not made of fabric.
Your ears have grown into tall, flexible and pretty rabbit ears.  They're are slender and enhance your hearing beyond the normal range.

//: TORSO
description: You have grown a thick shell over your torso, providing excellent armor, but you cannot wear anything on your torso.  Somewhat reduces wet effects.
Your protective shell has grown large enough to accommodate--if need be--your whole body.  Activate to pull your head and limbs into your shell, trading mobility and vision for warmth and shelter.
Your protective shell has developed increased strength and hardness and a mother of pearl sheen.

//: EXTRA ON TORSO
description: You have a short, stubby tail, like a rabbit's.  It serves no purpose.
You have a fin-like tail.  It allows you to swim more quickly, but prevents wearing non-fabric pants.  Slightly increases wet benefits.
You have a long, graceful tail, like that of a big cat.  It improves your balance, making your ability to dodge higher, but prevents wearing non-fabric pants.

//: Can swat away dermatik attacks and fungal spores, depending on DEX
description: You have a long tail with a tuft on the end.  You find yourself instinctively swatting away flies with it, though it's not as effective at balancing you as you'd like.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.
You have a long but hairless tail.  It's a pretty effective balancing aid, but does look, uh, ratty.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.
You have a long, thick, lizardlike tail.  It helps you balance a bit but also makes a serviceable whip.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.
You have a long and semi-stiff lizardlike tail.  You can't effectively strike with it in combat, but it significantly improves your balance.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.
You have a long, fluffy-furred tail.  It greatly improves your balance, making your ability to dodge much higher.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.
You have a long tail that ends in a vicious stinger.  It does not improve your balance at all, but allows for a powerful piercing attack.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.
You have a long tail that ends in a heavy, bony club.  It does not improve your balance at all, but allows for a powerful bashing attack.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.
Your stubby tail has become fuzzy and more round.  It looks adorable, but doesn't seem to serve another purpose beyond that.
You have a pair of stubby little wings projecting from your shoulderblades.  They can be wiggled at will, but are useless.

//: 50% chance to ignore a pit or a ledge
description: You have a very large pair of brightly-colored, very beautiful wings.  They can't lift you, and they make balancing tricky, but they certainly catch air and attention!
You have a pair of large, translucent wings.  They are too small to lift you, but are powerful enough to greatly speed your movement, with some effort and noise.
You have developed several vines sprouting from your shoulder area.  They're bulky, and get in the way.

//: Melee attack 2*STR/2 bash damage
description: You've developed the ability to control your vines; they make good lashes.  You can even rappel down sheer drops using them, but disconnecting HURTS.

//: Melee attack 3*STR/2 bash damage
description: You have full control of your vines, and can grow new ones and detach old ones more or less at will.

spawn_item.message: You detach a vine from your body.

//: ARMS
//2: Player-facing identical to the other arm preparation traits, slows down progression to feathered arms->wings
description: Your arms feel…different.  Occasionally something shifts under the skin - sometimes it does so without pain.  Whatever is happening in there, it's far from done.  <color_red><This change will be reversible.>

The feathers on your arms elongated and became stiff.  While they are impressive to look at and resistant to water and other contaminants, they always get in the way and you hate it when they get filthy.  <color_red><You can still go back to how you were.  If you continue on this path, that will change.>

//: Weaker, more fragile, clumsier, better swimmer but annoying when wet.
name: feathered arm
heading: BRB L Arm

//: 100% chance to ignore pits and ledges
description: Your feathered arms have elongated into proper wings.  Their new range of motion takes a lot of getting used to, and only two rudimentary fingers sticking out of your glorious plumage remind you of your original hands.  While they are too weak to properly take off, they should be enough to break your fall from any height.

//: Two talons per arm, terrible manipulation, even worse grip score.  Being a bird sucks.  Still, waterproof, keeps you warm, and better swimmer
name: left wing
heading: L. Wing

description: Your arms feel…different.  Occasionally something shifts under the skin - sometimes it does so without pain.  Whatever is happening in there, it's far from done.  <color_red><This change will be reversible.>

You have grown large membranes of skin on your arms, partly covering your wrist and little finger.  They're a challenge to fit into normal clothing, and are less dextrous on account of the extra bulk.  <color_red><This change will be reversible.>

//: Slightly larger and clumsier, same strength
name: leathery arm

description: Your arms have warped into large, leathery wings.  Your fingers are bound together by a thick leather membrane, making manual tasks extremely challenging, and your arms' bone structure has grown lightweight.  Still, you could probably use them to break your fall and all that surface helps keep you cool.

//: Same size as bird wings, slightly more dextrous, no armor and temp malus.
name: left wing

description: You have a strange-looking lump on each side of your torso, about where your ribcage used to end before it hid under your carapace.  You're sure they won't become a problem.

//: Two extra, twitching arms, your originals are still intact
//2: TODO: Put a cast on them to immobilize?
description: A pair of thin, many-jointed arms emerge from your midsection.  You can't control them properly, and they seem to twitch and grasp at your surroundings in the least opportunate moment.

//: No control over it, so just gets in the way - negative manipulation/balance/swim score
name: lower left arm
heading: L. Ins.  Arm

//: Two extra, cool arms on top of your base ones.  Some extra blockiness and manipulation score (not too much, until we do multiwield).  Not strong enough to count for twohanded stuff alone.
description: You're finally in control of your new, proper arms.  They're weak and fragile, but complement your five-fingered ape hands nicely when it comes to manual dexterity.

//: No balance malus, 20% manipulation and 10% grip/lift/crawl/swim bonus.
Postthresh creepy back arms, to go with the postthresh creepy waist legs.  You'll be able to skitter up and down walls with just the four, but these are not purifiable.  TODO: different gait?
description: You have two strange-looking lumps on your back, about the location of your shoulder blades.  You're sure they won't become a problem.<color_red><This change will be reversible.>

//: Same player-facing as the other types of morphing arms. Not a Threshold trait, meaning you can lose your normal arms way before being able to get the full set, same will be true of the legs.
description: Your arms feel…different.  Occasionally something shifts under the skin - sometimes it does so without pain.  Whatever is happening in there, it's far from done.  <color_red><This change will be reversible.>

//: Huge, twitching spider legs jutting out of your back.  Charming, and imbalances you like no tomorrow.
description: A pair of spindly, hairy spider legs emerge from your back.  You can't control them at all, and they are constantly twitching throwing you off balance and interfering with your movement.  Occasionally one of the more violent twitches draw the limbs further out, and you wonder how long they'll get.  <color_red><You can still go back to how you were.  If you continue on this path, that will change.>

//: No control, large target - double the balance malus of insect limbs, but on the back so no manipulation malus.
name: first left arm
heading: L. 1. Arm

//: Absorbing your fingers, three claws you can't quite use and a lot of hair distracting you.
description: Your arms and hands have started…shifting.  Long bristles emerge from where your forearms used to be, and your fingers are starting to fuse into three sharp claws.  The bristles are very sensitive, distracting you constantly, and your manual dexterity suffers greatly. <color_red><You can still go back to how you were.  If you continue on this path, that will change.>

//: Drastically reduced manipulation score, hand replacement, unarmed damage but lowers balance.
name: second left arm
heading: L. 2. Arm

//: Postthresh, nonpurifiable, flaily clawy spider arms. +Unarmed damage
description: Your back now sports two huge, segmented spider legs.  They aren't enough to crawl properly on their own, but at least they stopped getting in your way with their constant twitching.  The claws on their ends could probably do some damage, and help with manual tasks minimally.

//: Good enough to pitch in on crafting (bringing you to 80% base with all four), blocky, unarmed damage, zoomy crawling and wall clinging.
Pre-thresh, nonpurifiable? +Unarmed damage
description: You are finally free of those flailing bits of flesh jutting out of your carapace.  Your second pair of arms now looks mature - they aren't enough to crawl properly on their own, but the claws on their ends could probably do some damage.  Fine manipulation is a challenge unless you have the whole set, though.

//: As strong as normal arms, slightly blockier thanks to the joints.  No balance malus anymore
Miss messge, obsolete
description: There's the last two limbs you were expecting.  Unfortunately, you still can't coordinate them, so you're getting in your own way.  A lot.

//: +2 Dex if torso uncovered, otherwise -2 and miss message. Climb chainlink fences for 75 moves if torso is uncovered. Obsolete
description: You have four handsome limbs, and then those mutant 'hand' and 'foot' things.  They probably aren't worth concealing.

//: Same player-facing as the other types of morphing arms. Not a Threshold trait.
description: Your arms feel…different.  Occasionally something shifts under the skin - sometimes it does so without pain.  Whatever is happening in there, it's far from done.  <color_red><This change will be reversible.>

//: If you have a hand free attacks for STR/3+1 bash damage
//2: Strong, clumsy, grippy arms and hand replacement.  Horrible manipulation, bad lift score, aight grip. Purifiable pre-thresh
description: Your arms and hands have transformed into thick, glistening tentacles.  The suckers make for great grip, but lacking bones their strength is less than you remember - and needless to say missing your fingers lead to horrible fine manipulation.<color_red><You can still go back to how you were.  If you continue on this path, that will change.>
//description: Your arms have transformed into tentacles, resulting in a +1 bonus to Dexterity, permanent hand encumbrance of 30, and an inability to wear gloves.  Somewhat decreases wet penalties.

//: Clumsy, weak arms.  The grip, free mending and bash armor is nice, though.
name: left tentacle
heading: L. Tentacle

//: If you have a hand free attacks for (STR/3+1)*3 bash damage, otherwise for (STR/3+1)*2
//2: All right manipulation, strong melee attacks, can either progress to 8tentacles for weak shooty/manipulaty octopi or tentacle rakes +- venomous for a melee-oriented flavor.  Non-purifiable postthresh, you're stuck with some type of tentacles now.  Not a claw-type to allow for tentacle rakes
description: Your featureless arms have split in two, leaving four thick tentacles emerging from your shoulders.  They are about as strong as your original bony arms were, but fine manipulation continues to be challenging

//: Summed 0.28 balance, 0.8 manipulation, 2.4 grip, 1 lift, 1 swim, 0.8 crawl; Blockier for the wider range of motion
//2: Hand 1.0 manip, 1.0 grip, 0.3 swim Arm 0.3 balance, 1 lift, 0.2 swim, 0.6 crawl
name: left upper tentacle
heading: L. U. Tentacle

//: Modifies tentacle mutation's attack formula to (STR/2+1)*n cut damage
//2: Adds some nasty claws to your tentacles - unarmed damage up and dedicated tech, but manipulation is worse
description: Your upper tentacles have grown large, hook-barbed rakes on the ends.  They're quite vicious, but really aren't suited for fine manipulation.

//: Brings down the manipulation score to 0.6 for the full set, unlocks angry cut attacks and envenoming.  No hitsize to prevent your flabby arms from being damaged by hitting the hard claw
name: left upper claw
heading: L. U. Claw

//: If you have a hand free attacks for (STR/3+1)*7 bash damage, otherwise for (STR/3+1)*6
//2: Very manipulaty, pretty grippy, fragile as hell and too weak for dedicated attacks
description: Where your arms used to be you now have two tangles of four tentacles each - they seek to weave together at rest or when exerting large force, but you can separate them when fine manipulation is needed.  Without bones they are much weaker than your old arms were, but their tips branch into three small manipulators and the suckers still offer great grip.

//: Summed 0.28 balance, 1.4 manipulation, 2.0 grip, 0.8 lift, 1.6 swim, 0.8 crawl; just about able to block once
//2: Hand 1.0 manip, 1.0 grip, 0.3 swim Arm 0.3 balance, 1 lift, 0.2 swim, 0.6 crawl
name: left first tentacle
heading: L. 1. Tentacle

//: HANDS
description: Your fingernails are long and sharp.  If you aren't wearing gloves, your unarmed attacks deal a minor amount of cutting damage.
You have claws on the ends of your fingers.  If you aren't wearing gloves, your unarmed attacks deal a minor amount of cutting damage.
Your claws have grown tougher and slightly gnarled.
Your paws are bone, muscle, and claw with a thin layer of skin and fur.  They might as well be made of stainless steel.
You have claws on the ends of your fingers, and can extend or retract them as desired.  Gloves will still get in the way, though.
Sharp claws are extending from the end of your fingers.
Your index fingers have grown into huge talons.  After a bit of practice, you find that this does not affect your dexterity, but allows for a deadly unarmed attack.  They also prevent wearing gloves.
The skin on your hands is now a mucous membrane that produces a thick, acrid slime.  Attacks using your hand will cause minor acid damage.  Slightly increases wet benefits.

//: Miss messge, hardcoded Str-dependent swim speed bonus
description: Your hands and feet are heavily webbed, reducing your Dexterity by 1 and causing problems with gloves.  However, you can swim much faster.  Slightly decreases wet penalties.

//: Str-dependent swim speed modifier
description: Your hands have fused into quasi-paws.  Fine manipulation is a challenge: permanent hand encumbrance of 10, difficulty with delicate craftwork, and your gloves don't fit.  But they handle water better.

//: Str-dependent swim speed modifier
description: Your paws are much larger now.  Manual dexterity is difficult: permanent hand encumbrance of 20, serious problems crafting, and no gloves.  In return, though, you can swim better.
Your hands have elongated and look a bit more like paws.  It makes fine manipulation a little more difficult, but you can still probably manage.

//: LEGS
//2: No penalty for not wearing shoes
description: Your legs have transformed into six tentacles.  This decreases your speed on land by 20%, makes your movement silent, increases your swimming speed, and reduces wet penalties.

//: Immune to being downed or knocked back when not wearing shoes, chance to avoid being pushed off stairs
description: Your lower tentacles have developed suckers.  They make land movement marginally more tiring, but do a good job of keeping you set in place.
Your legs have gained muscle mass to propel you across any terrain.
You've gained a strong ability to leap a short distance from a standing position with little preparation time.
//: This is differentiated from the other two leaps by a shorter range yet a shorter prep time. Probably less useful than them since it will still exhaust you.

description: You've gained a strong ability to leap from a standing position.
You've gained a strong ability to leap a significant distance from a standing position and crush whatever you land on.

Your legs have consolidated into a single muscular 'foot' that goes up into your belly.  You move about a fourth of your previous speed and can no longer wear pants or shoes, on the other hand you make significantly less noise.  In addition to being harder to knock down, you can move through sludge-covered surfaces easily.

//: FEET
description: The bottoms of your feet are strongly padded.  You receive no movement penalty for not wearing shoes, and even receive a 10% bonus when moving barefoot.
You have grown large, curved, and wickedly sharp talons in place of your big toes.  Fortunately, they don't get in the way of your movement.  Unfortunately, they do prevent wearing footgear.

//: Doesn't actually check for kicking attacks
description: Your feet have fused into hooves.  This allows kicking attacks to do much more damage, provides natural armor, and removes the need to wear shoes; however, you cannot wear shoes of any kind.  Reduces wet effects.

//: Fast tree communion, Half thirst/hunger/sleep while communing with trees, no penalty for no shoes, morale down from shoes

description.//~: The idea is that you, for lack of a better term, plant yourself.  Crafting and digging don't count because they presume a certain amount of movement during the task.  The handheld game does count.
description.str: It's about time you started developing a root system.  When reading, fishing, waiting, or otherwise being stationary for a while on diggable terrain, you'll extract nutrients and water from the soil.

//: Same as ROOTS2, just slower move speed
description: You find it difficult not to sink roots when able.  You extract nutrients and water whenever on diggable terrain, but move more slowly.

Your feet have grown into strong and large rabbit feet.  This makes your kicks pack a little more oomph.  Emphasis on little.  It also offers some warmth, and the lucky part is but superstition.  The downside is you are unable to wear shoes.

attacks.attack_text_u: You kick %s with your large feet

//: GENERAL?
description: Your pseudopod-like limbs can fit into anything!  +4 Dexterity, -4 Strength.

//: Resist flashbangs, fine vision not impaired by bile or darkness (?), in general no sigh_impaired() (??)
description: You can now extend and reabsorb sensory organs at will, and can therefore ignore most shocks that would overwhelm lesser beings.

//: Blinds, deafens and hallucinates once an hour each, slightly resist flashbangs, always sight_impaired(?)
description: Your sense organs are all over the place: eyes extending and retracting, 'ears' of various shapes migrating about, and taste & smell are uncontrollable.  The world is a horrible mixup.  Ugh!
Your flesh is a pleasing gel-like consistency.  Your bodily functions seem to be moving around, and your leg-equivalents flow comfortably - if a little slower than your old meat-legs.
